# Setup

## Packages

```{r packages}
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library("Rmisc")
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library("ggh4x")

#paths are relative to this .Rmd's folder (02.diversity), which is the working directory when knitting
```

## Read in data

```{r read in data}
ps.clean1 <- readRDS("../01.make.asv.table/ps.ready.rds")

##clonemates removed (KA = KG, VB = VD; one of each pair kept)
ps.clean <- subset_samples(ps.clean1,genotype_original!="KA" & genotype_original!="VB")
ps.clean #31 samples

samdf <- data.frame(ps.clean@sam_data)
```

## Calculate metrics

[Notes from phyloseq author](https://rdrr.io/bioc/phyloseq/man/estimate_richness.html)

```{r generate div metrics}
df <- data.frame(estimate_richness(ps.clean, split=TRUE, measures=c("Shannon","InvSimpson","Observed")))

df$sample_name <- rownames(df)
df$sample_name <- gsub(".","-",df$sample_name,fixed=TRUE)
rownames(df) <- df$sample_name
df.div <- merge(df,samdf,by="sample_name") #add sample data

#shannon diversity divided by species richness
df.div$even <- df.div$Shannon/(log(df.div$Observed))

##saved for the multi-panel figure made in ../03.comm.comp
write.csv(df.div,file="dtv.16s.alphadiv.csv",row.names=FALSE)
```

Labels for plotting

```{r relabel}
df.div$timepoint <- gsub("preheat","Primed",df.div$timepoint)
df.div$timepoint <- gsub("postheat","Heat",df.div$timepoint)
df.div$timepoint <- factor(df.div$timepoint,levels=c("Primed","Heat"))

df.div$host_species <- gsub("franksi","O. franksi",df.div$host_species)
df.div$host_species <- gsub("faveolata","O. faveolata",df.div$host_species)

df.div$treat_time <- factor(df.div$treat_time,levels=c("contr_pre","contr_pos","therm_pre","therm_pos"))

df.div.fav <- subset(df.div,host_species=="O. faveolata")
df.div.fra <- subset(df.div,host_species=="O. franksi")
```

## Plotting function

```{r plot function}
##dot & error bars; same style as manuscript Fig. 3D
plot_div <- function(dat, metric, ylabel){
  dat.se <- summarySE(data=dat,measurevar=metric,groupvars=c("treat_time","treatment","timepoint","host_species"))
  dat.se$ymin <- dat.se[[metric]]-dat.se$se
  dat.se$ymax <- dat.se[[metric]]+dat.se$se
  ggplot(dat,aes(x=timepoint,y=.data[[metric]],shape=treat_time,fill=treat_time))+
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.1),alpha=0.3,size=4)+
    geom_errorbar(data=dat.se,aes(ymin=ymin,ymax=ymax),position=position_dodge(width=0.5),width=0.2)+
    geom_point(data=dat.se,aes(x=timepoint,y=.data[[metric]]),position=position_dodge(width=0.5),size=5)+
    facet_grid2(~host_species, strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("#8B7355","#CDAB7D")),text_x = elem_list_text(size = 14, face = "bold.italic", color = "white")))+
    scale_fill_manual(name="Priming x Heat",values=c("#2C2673","#9187FF","#E24A13","#FFA45E"),labels=c("Stable-Primed","Stable-Heat","DTV-Primed","DTV-Heat"))+
    scale_shape_manual(name="Priming x Heat",values=c(22,22,23,23),labels=c("Stable-Primed","Stable-Heat","DTV-Primed","DTV-Heat"))+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          legend.text=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color="black"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"))+
    xlab("")+
    ylab(ylabel)
}
```

# Alpha diversity plots {.tabset}

## Shannon

```{r shannon plot}
gg.shan.both <- plot_div(df.div,"Shannon","Shannon index")
gg.shan.both
```

## Simpson

```{r simpson plot}
gg.simp <- plot_div(df.div,"InvSimpson","Inverse Simpson index")
gg.simp
```

# Shannon stats

## O. faveolata

```{r shannon stats fav}
df.div.fav$treatment <- as.factor(df.div.fav$treatment)
df.div.fav$genotype <- as.factor(df.div.fav$genotype)

#from here: https://exeter-data-analytics.github.io/StatModelling/04-mixed-effects-models-handout.pdf
lmer.sha.fav <- lmer(Shannon ~ treatment*timepoint + (1|genotype), data = df.div.fav)

Anova(lmer.sha.fav, test = "F")
#timepoint F = 11.14, p = 0.00998 (manuscript Fig. 3D: P_Heat = 0.01); treatment & interaction n.s.

emmeans(lmer.sha.fav, list(pairwise ~ timepoint|treatment), adjust = "none")
#thermvar: Primed - Heat p = 0.0182 (manuscript Fig. 3D: P = 0.018); control: p = 0.125
emmeans(lmer.sha.fav, list(pairwise ~ treatment|timepoint), adjust = "none")
```

## O. franksi

```{r shannon stats fra}
df.div.fra$treatment <- as.factor(df.div.fra$treatment)
df.div.fra$genotype <- as.factor(df.div.fra$genotype)

lmer.sha.fra <- lmer(Shannon ~ treatment*timepoint + (1|genotype), data = df.div.fra)

Anova(lmer.sha.fra, test = "F")
#all n.s.

emmeans(lmer.sha.fra, list(pairwise ~ timepoint|treatment), adjust = "none")
emmeans(lmer.sha.fra, list(pairwise ~ treatment|timepoint), adjust = "none")
```

```{r simpson stats fav}
Anova(lmer.simp.fav, test = "F")
#timepoint F = 5.37, p = 0.048; treatment & interaction n.s.
#thermvar: Primed - Heat p = 0.050

emmeans(lmer.simp.fav, list(pairwise ~ timepoint|treatment), adjust = "none")
emmeans(lmer.simp.fav, list(pairwise ~ treatment|timepoint), adjust = "none")
```

```{r simpson stats fra}
emmeans(lmer.simp.fra, list(pairwise ~ treatment|timepoint), adjust = "none")
```

# Rarefied

Done once and saved, because rarefying is random (no seed was set).

```{r rarefy, eval=F}
seqtab.ps <- data.frame(ps.clean@otu_table)
taxa <- readRDS("../01.make.asv.table/dtv.16s.taxa.withids.rds")

rarecurve(seqtab.ps,step=500,label=FALSE)

total <- rowSums(seqtab.ps)
fewer <- subset(total, total <3149)
fewer.df <- data.frame(fewer)
fewer.df
#        fewer
# VE18-1  1881

samples.remove <- c(row.names(fewer.df))
seqtab.less <- seqtab.ps[!row.names(seqtab.ps)%in% samples.remove,]
#leaves 30 samples

seqtab.rare <- rrarefy(seqtab.less,sample=3149)

rarecurve(seqtab.rare,step=500,label=FALSE)

#phyloseq object but rarefied
ps.rare1 <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.rare, taxa_are_rows=FALSE),
                    sample_data(samdf),
                    tax_table(taxa))
ps.rare1
# otu_table()   OTU Table:          [ 465 taxa and 30 samples ]:

#removing missing taxa - lost after rarefying
ps.rare <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.rare1) > 0, ps.rare1)
ps.rare
# otu_table()   OTU Table:          [ 415 taxa and 30 samples ]:

#saveRDS(ps.rare,file="dtv.ps.rare.3100.rds")
```

Re-read in data, skipping rarefying above

```{r rare read in}
ps.rare <- readRDS("dtv.ps.rare.3100.rds")
ps.rare
unique(sample_sums(ps.rare)) #3149

samdf.rare <- data.frame(ps.rare@sam_data)

df.rare <- data.frame(estimate_richness(ps.rare, split=TRUE, measures=c("Shannon","InvSimpson","Observed")))

df.rare$sample_name <- rownames(df.rare)
df.rare$sample_name <- gsub(".","-",df.rare$sample_name,fixed=TRUE)
rownames(df.rare) <- df.rare$sample_name
df.rare.div <- merge(df.rare,samdf.rare,by="sample_name") #add sample data

#shannon diversity divided by species richness
df.rare.div$even <- df.rare.div$Shannon/(log(df.rare.div$Observed))

df.rare.div$timepoint <- gsub("preheat","Primed",df.rare.div$timepoint)
df.rare.div$timepoint <- gsub("postheat","Heat",df.rare.div$timepoint)
df.rare.div$timepoint <- factor(df.rare.div$timepoint,levels=c("Primed","Heat"))

df.rare.div$host_species <- gsub("franksi","O. franksi",df.rare.div$host_species)
df.rare.div$host_species <- gsub("faveolata","O. faveolata",df.rare.div$host_species)

df.rare.div$treat_time <- factor(df.rare.div$treat_time,levels=c("contr_pre","contr_pos","therm_pre","therm_pos"))

#separate species
df.rare.div.fra <- subset(df.rare.div,host_species=="O. franksi")
df.rare.div.fav <- subset(df.rare.div,host_species=="O. faveolata")
```
